title: Mindoro ride-booking app seeks to boost tricycle drivers’ income

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A mobile application developed in Mindoro aims to make tricycle commuting more convenient while providing local drivers with additional income opportunities through digital ride-booking services. Developed by 34-year-old entrepreneur Rhaiven Rein Pasno, Tamarraw Go allows passengers to book tricycle rides, view estimated fares and request rides through their mobile phones.
